title: Quality Improvement Strategies to Increase Human Papillomavirus (HPV) Vaccination
brief_summary: HPV vaccination is at lower levels than the national goals. This study will evaluate the effectiveness of quality improvement strategies for increasing HPV vaccination coverage among adolescents in primary care clinics.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Pediatric or family medicine clinics or practices in New York, Wisconsin, or Arizona with at least 200 active records for patients, ages 11-17, in their states' immunization information systems.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Less than 200 active records for patients between 11-17
